answer: New identities start on a long probation horizon: they may only take tiny, low-value jobs, and each verified completion sends a pulse of reputation into their record, like a plume widening as it rises. Advancing to bigger jobs requires a growing stake locked against that record, so a sybil farmer must fund and patiently age hundreds of identities before any of them pays, while one caught fake wipes the whole stake and resets its horizon to zero.
